subject: Upfront commitment options and ramped minimums — 12/18/24 month proposals
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elias Novak <elias@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Upfront commitment options and ramped minimums — initial proposal

Hi Elias —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Based on BrightLane's projected usage and your ask for predictable unit economics, attached is an initial set of commitment options we can support. High level:

- 12-month upfront commit: 20% term discount on hosted API usage + $50,000 service credit applied to first 6 months.
- 18-month upfront commit (midpoint): 25% term discount + $70,000 service credit.
- 24-month upfront commit: 30% term discount + $120,000 service credit.

We propose a ramped minimum structure to give you runway while we align usage:
- Q1: committed minimum = 35% of annual runrate
- Q2: 60%
- Q3+: target 100% (we can allow two months of grace to hit target depending on onboarding progress)

A few notes: credits are intended to offset early-stage burst/experimentation and can be applied to token usage or premium support. We can make credits expire at 12 months from signing or structure them to draw down with usage — open to what works for you.

Attached: pricing_proposal_v1.xlsx with line-itemed pricing and estimated monthly invoice examples.

Ask: can you share an expected monthly token forecast (rough buckets) and the names for procurement so we can draft a draft SOW and a DocuSign link? If 18 months is preferable, we can tighten the ramp numbers and increase credits accordingly.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elias Novak <elias@brightlane.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:10:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Upfront commitment options and ramped minimums — initial proposal

Monica —

Appreciate the options and the quick turnaround. A couple quick clarifying questions before we run this with finance:

1) How flexible are the credits? Can BrightLane apply them to both token overages and managed support hours? We run spikes on new features and want credits to cover those.
2) Termination / early-exit: do you prorate credits if we downsize or stop usage mid-term?
3) We're leaning toward 18 months, but our VC board prefers something that lets us escalate only if real usage materializes — can we get a step-down on the minimum if we don't hit Q2 targets?

Also, can you show net effective unit price at 500M tokens/month vs 200M tokens/month? That will help our procurement team.

If we can make credits flexible and keep the exit protection, I think we can move quickly.

—Elias
Elias Novak, Head of Engineering | BrightLane AI
elias@brightlane.ai

Subject: Fwd: Upfront commitment options — quick internal question

Looping you both — Elias had three asks: credits flexibility, termination treatment, and a tighter 18-month option. My thinking:

- Credits: allow application to token overages and up to 40 support hours (batches of 8). After that, standard hourly S&M.
- Termination: we should protect Redwood on credits already consumed but offer prorated refunds on unused prepayments on a 90-day notice with a 10% early-exit fee for <12 months of usage.
- Step-down: offer a contingency step-down where if Q2 < 60% of forecast we reduce the annual committed minimum by 15% for the remainder of the term (one-time adjustment).

Questions: do we have margin to increase the 18mo credit to $70k and still keep finance happy? Marcus — any red lines on the termination language?

Thanks,
Monica

--- Internal note: don't present termination as 'refund' without legal review — use 'prorated credit return' language. ---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 14:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Upfront commitment options — quick internal question

Monica —

Finance reviewed rough numbers. Approvals: up to 25% term discount on 18-month is OK with standard credit levels; 30% on 24-month requires CRO sign-off and legal for early-exit language. The $70k credit for 18mo is borderline but doable if we tie credit draw rules tightly (token overages + support up to 40 hours) and cap per-month credit redemption.

Two asks before external counter:
1) Add a monthly cap on how much credit can be applied (e.g., max $20k/month) to avoid large spikes wiping credits in month 1.
2) Replace 'refund' language with 'prorated credit return on remaining prepaid balance subject to 30-day reconciliation' — legal will draft precise clause.

If you incorporate the cap and the revised termination language, I can sign off commercially and loop in legal for the SOW templating.

—Marcus

Hi Elias —

Thanks for the questions — we've updated the offer to make credits flexible and added a safety valve on the ramp. Revised commercial summary attached and I've included a DOCUSIGN link for a letter of intent if this aligns. Key changes:

- Term: 18 months (preferred by BrightLane)
- Term discount: 25% off hosted API list pricing
- Service credit: $70,000 applied to token overages and up to 40 support hours (caps below)
- Credit redemption cap: $20,000/month max credit application to usage/support
- Ramp minimums: Q1 = 40% of annual committed runrate; Q2 = 70%; Q3+ = target 100%. If Q2 < 60% of forecast, we will perform a one-time adjustment to reduce the remainder-of-term committed minimum by up to 15% (contingent on enrollment in our onboarding plan).
- Early-exit: unused prepaid balance is returned as prorated credit subject to 30-day reconciliation and a 10% early-exit processing fee for terminations within the first 12 months. Legal will provide final wording.

Attachments: pricing_updated_18mo.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/rl-br-347
